scope: Investigation decisions only. No existing job, queue item or published topic was changed.

decisions.reason: Contributor IDs collapse many writers and can be shared/multiple; they cannot support strict person-held-out claims.
decisions.replacement: Conditional ST5 class-incremental/ambiguity study, explicitly without an unseen-writer claim.

decisions.proposal: OneShot has not tested noisy confirmations or temporal order
decisions.reason: The paper's appendices already test these cases.
decisions.replacement: ST8 cross-series trained combiner; count all pretraining labels and compare with supervised logistic and statistical rules.

decisions.proposal: Metadata gating or uploader-disjoint audio evaluation is new
decisions.reason: The complete DCASE report describes both, plus text dropout and conservative parent gating.
decisions.replacement: ST1 controlled reliability/coverage/parameter-budget comparison against those established methods.

decisions.proposal: Treat CodeSearchNet's whole corpus as MIT
decisions.reason: MIT covers repository code/docs; the source corpus has per-origin license metadata.
decisions.replacement: ST9 direct audited repositories, file-level exclusions, pinned snapshots and attribution.

decisions.proposal: Use October waste paper's collected image corpus
decisions.reason: A concrete downloadable corpus/file license was not established from its data statement.
decisions.replacement: ST4 public TACO, with collection-versus-per-image provenance limits made explicit.

decisions.proposal: Treat AICOS article terms as sensor-data license
decisions.reason: Article and dataset have different terms; the primary Zenodo dataset explicitly declares CC-BY-4.0.
decisions.replacement: Use dataset record/README as the data evidence; model terms remain separate.

decisions.proposal: Commercialise MovieLens-based training without further rights
decisions.reason: Official terms require separate permission for commercial use and redistribution.
decisions.replacement: ST10 is conditional research only; public artifacts contain aggregate counts and scripts/plans, no raw dataset.

decisions.proposal: Assume all small MobileNet weight releases have the same permissive license
decisions.reason: Use a specifically inspected weight card rather than importing licensing from an architecture name.

decisions.proposal: Count Task-UtilityIQA as an October new lead
decisions.reason: Original source date is September 30 despite October aggregator listings.

decisions.proposal: Use LinkedIn event dates or Reddit relative dates as post dates
decisions.reason: Original post dates were not reliable; official OmniParse announcement supplies its own October 8 date.
decisions.replacement: Undated community context, no current-trend/demand inference.

decisions.proposal: Build another agent IDE/design-skill thesis because it is Trending
decisions.reason: Popularity/product features do not establish a scientific question, usable evaluation data or unmet demand.

decisions.proposal: Count a forecast adaptation study as a new distinct tenth topic
decisions.reason: This overlaps existing T6. It is retained only as a concrete refinement, not counted among ST1–ST10.
decisions.replacement: See extra-t6-refinement.txt; no old scope or job changed.

decisions.proposal: ST5 as a standard small-image classifier/prototype demo
decisions.reason: Too close to coursework unless the ambiguity, forgetting, unknown-class and memory-budget study is justified. Direct current evidence for the exact question is weak.
decisions.replacement: Conditional detailed brief with explicit qualification gates, not an endorsed tenth slot.

decisions.proposal: ST7 as ordinary context sampling plus calibration
decisions.reason: Needs a nontrivial foundation-model adaptation question beyond analytic prior correction, plus feasible measured CPU cost.
decisions.replacement: Bounded mechanism study; retain all conditions and negative results. Withdraw if routine correction answers the whole question.

decisions.proposal: ST10 as a random-split MovieLens model comparison
decisions.reason: Mature textbook-adjacent setting. Must study an independently justified adapter, strict new-user/time separation, timestamp ties and relevance/coverage trade-offs.
decisions.replacement: Conditional temporal adaptation protocol; data cohort is verified, models are not.

decisions.proposal: Private industrial records or an external company partner as a prerequisite
decisions.reason: Incompatible with the user's solo-access constraint. Existing NT3-style incident retrieval requiring private linked incident logs needs a new public-data scope or archival; such linked data were not established here.
decisions.replacement: Root should audit affected old cards. T4/T5 need not be archived merely for being industrial if a genuinely public offline dataset supports their question; remove private factory/deployment claims. No old job changed.

decisions.proposal: Treat a ZIP header/prefix as proof that a whole usable dataset was decoded
decisions.reason: Prefixes and complete members establish different things.
decisions.replacement: Compact receipts explicitly identify complete CRC/format parses versus bounded partial samples, plus unresolved full-subset work.

shortfall: Ten possibilities were investigated, but only seven are kept without a substantiality revision flag. ST5, ST7 and ST10 remain conditional/revise. This is an honest qualification shortfall, not ten endorsements.
automatic_actions: No jobs enqueued, messages sent to third parties, datasets republished, deployments or global configurations changed.
